personality_one_liner: A high-performance, command-center interface optimized for live tracking, rapid field operations, and clear status visibility, unifying the dark-gold Zenrex brand.

spacing.rule: Dense information architecture with highly legible margins. Use md for related grouping, lg/xl for module separation. Essential for single-handed use while driving.

do's: Use solid surfaceSecondary and surfaceTertiary for elevated elements to maintain maximum contrast and readability under sunlight.
dont's: Do not use blur or glassmorphism on the driver map overlay to avoid lagging the map rendering and washing out readability.

platform_libraries.maps: react-native-webview (wrapping MapLibre GL with Protomaps vector tiles)

screens.name: Driver Home (Map)
screens.purpose: Full-screen branded map showing driver location, heatmaps, and a main action slider to go online/offline.

states.loading: Map skeleton with centered brand-colored pulse.
states.error: Offline banner above map, retry connection button.

screens.layout: Map takes full height. Top floating chip for today's earnings. Bottom container anchored at bottom safe area: displays current status (Offline/Online) and a large, pill-shaped 'Swipe to go Online/Offline' slider mechanism. Uses RTL flex directions for Arabic.

screens.name: Order Offer (Bottom Sheet Modal)
screens.purpose: Interruptive modal over map to accept or decline incoming delivery offers.

states.loading: Shimmer effect on distance and pricing.

screens.layout: Bottom-sheet modal covering lower 50%. Includes a circular progress/countdown ring (30s) around a delivery icon. Key metrics (ETA, Earning, Distance, COD/Prepaid) stacked in a 2x2 grid. Large 'Accept' primary button, secondary 'Decline' text link. Action buttons pinned above bottom safe area.

screens.name: Active Delivery (Stepper Flow)
screens.purpose: Replaces the home bottom container when an order is active. Guides driver through Pickup to Drop-off.

states.error: Error boundary if route calculation fails.

screens.layout: Persistent bottom sheet that can be dragged to peek. Step indicator (horizontal line with dots). Action row (Navigate, Call, Chat). Primary CTA updates sequentially: 'Arrived at Store' -> 'Confirm Pickup' -> 'Arrived at Customer' -> 'Deliver (OTP/Photo)'. Map routes are dynamically drawn based on the current step.

screens.name: Earnings & Wallet
screens.purpose: Tracks daily/weekly earnings and manages payouts.

states.empty: Empty state illustration of a wallet + 'Complete your first trip to see earnings'.
states.error: Failed to load data, tap to retry.

screens.layout: Standard list view. Top section contains large typography for 'Balance' and a 'Request Payout' button. Below: Bar chart for weekly earnings. Bottom section: List of recent transactions/trips.

screens.name: Performance
screens.purpose: Displays metrics like acceptance rate and completed trips.
screens.layout: Grid of surfaceSecondary cards displaying big numbers (e.g., 98% Acceptance). Includes a 'Badges/Levels' visual tracker.

screens.name: Profile & Documents
screens.purpose: Manages driver identity, vehicle details, and legal documents.
screens.layout: Scrollable list of document items (ID, License, Registration). Each item shows status (Pending, Approved, Upload Needed). Real driver photo at top in a circular avatar.

empty_earnings.alt: Delivery driver riding scooter at night

instructions_to_main_agent: Strictly adhere to RTL (Right-to-Left) layout for the Arabic interface. Navigation buttons and content alignment must flip accordingly.
Do NOT use Google Maps. Use `react-native-webview` rendering a MapLibre GL instance pointing to a self-hosted Protomaps / Overture tileset as explicitly requested by user.
MAP STYLING JSON (Pass these colors into MapLibre GL style configuration):
DARK MAP: background/land: '#17151A', water: '#111014', roads: '#26242B', road-outlines: '#2E2A36', buildings: '#2A2731', labels: '#EFECE7', poi-highlights: '#C9A85C'.
LIGHT MAP: background/land: '#F9F9F9', water: '#E4E9ED', roads: '#EBEBEB', road-outlines: '#E5E5E5', buildings: '#FFFFFF', labels: '#17151A', poi-highlights: '#B8924A'.
Implement real-time location updates (1-2s intervals) using WebSocket or similar fast-polling mechanism with animated marker interpolation on the MapLibre instance.
For the Order Offer screen, implement a visual countdown ring (30s) using react-native-reanimated. The CTA should be a large swipeable button ('Swipe to Accept') to prevent accidental touches.
For the Active Delivery flow, OTP input or camera integration for proof-of-delivery must be built directly into the 'Drop-off' step before the job is marked complete.
Ensure 'Dark-First Utility' principles are followed: no blurs, strong boundaries, high contrast, and large typography for metrics.
Extend the existing theme tokens rather than replacing them, utilizing the `light` object provided in the color schema for light mode support.
